current.scope: Only pages represented in review_labels.csv are scored; other output pages are unreviewed.
current.supported_scope: All supported labels, including nested components, enter total TP/FP/FN.
current.stratum_policy: Direct and nested strata report recall only; all false positives remain in the primary page-occurrence score because candidates do not predict a target level.
current.report_item_set_policy: Deduplicate supported (report_id, canonical_item, target_level) keys; a set item is recalled only if at least one supported page occurrence is matched. Page-occurrence errors remain in the primary score.
